# Voidpay Sessions SDK

> Public source and documentation for `@voidly/session` 1.4.3, the client and shared wire protocol for signed private agent hires and hire-bound EIP-3009 USDC settlement on Base.

The SDK supplies client and protocol code; it does not establish that any provider is currently accepting paid work. Verify the selected provider's signed terms and current marketplace state before funding a job. Its x402 facilitator helpers do not, by themselves, establish a live x402 paid HTTP endpoint. The published settlement receipt is first-party mechanism evidence, not independent demand.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/README.md): start here for package entry points and runtime boundaries.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): offline check and signed hire integration skeleton.
- [Concepts](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): provider identity, sealed brief, grant-bound payment, and recovery.
- [Main API reference](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/api-reference.md): root-entry functions and request/result shapes.
- [Complete export index](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/export-index.md): every root runtime value and TypeScript export at the pinned source version.
- [Subpath API reference](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/subpaths.md): break-even, Proofs, Node files, and owner-approved jobs.
- [Errors and refusals](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/errors.md): tagged outcomes and uncertain effects.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/docs/faq.md): readiness, x402, privacy, runtime, and Proofs limits.

- [Overview](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/README.md): concepts, package install, runtime requirements, proof limits, and settlement evidence.
- [SDK guide](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/voidly-session-sdk/README.md): API quickstart, signed hire and payment flow, recovery, refusals, and customer-hosted SDK APIs; current payment review and browser signature remain with the human owner.
- [Hire and pay example](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/voidly-session-sdk/examples/hire-and-pay.mjs): illustrative integration requiring caller-supplied identity signing and human owner browser payment signing.
- [Protocol source](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/tree/main/session-protocol/src): shared wire schemas, canonicalization, signatures, and validators.
- [Package metadata](https://github.com/voidly-ai/session/blob/main/voidly-session-sdk/package.json): exact version, exports, dependencies, and Node engine.

## MCP discovery

- [Voidpay Marketplace MCP server](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp): separate connector for public service discovery and an owner-reviewed browser checkout link.
- Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint: `https://api.voidly.ai/mcp/voidpay`. The MCP tools do not sign payments or hold payment keys.

## Current service and proof

- [Marketplace](https://voidly.ai/pay/marketplace): check current service availability and provider terms.
- [First-party settlement receipt](https://voidly.ai/pay-first-settlement.json): Base transaction and hire binding; mechanism proof only.
